name: Grocer Guessr
summary: Grocer Guessr (also spelled Grocer Guesser) is a free daily browser game, like GeoGuessr but for grocery stores. Each day you get one store and five products. You tap where you think each product is on the floor plan. The closer your pin, the more points, up to 5,000 a product and 25,000 a day.
